party_basis: the last party primary each voter voted in (the 2024 and 2026 primaries and runoffs, including March 2024's presidential primary)

party_hints.cast: Everyone who has voted so far by the last party primary they voted in (the 2024 and 2026 primaries and runoffs, including March 2024's presidential primary), from the Secretary of State's voter files. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.
party_hints.mail_voted: Mail ballots received by the last party primary they voted in (the 2024 and 2026 primaries and runoffs, including March 2024's presidential primary), from the Secretary of State's voter files. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.
party_hints.early_voted: In-person early voters by the last party primary they voted in (the 2024 and 2026 primaries and runoffs, including March 2024's presidential primary), from the Secretary of State's voter files. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.

party_methods_note: Party comes from early and mail voters matched to their primary history, so this category is turnout only.
unk_label: counted, but not in the voter file matched to primaries
map_note: Georgia has no party registration and its primaries are open, so a primary ballot isn't a party registration. Party is matched voter by voter from the Secretary of State's Voter History Files and Voter Absentee File (through Oct 30). The absentee file is downloaded by hand, so ballots counted after it and Election Day ballots show as party not reported.

demographics.note: Ballots cast so far by the age group, gender and race on each voter's registration record, from the GA SoS Election Data Hub (its categories; Unknown = no linked voter record).

source.primary: GA SoS Election Data Hub (Qlik): accepted ballots by county & method; party by last primary from the SoS voter files
source.hub_election: NOVEMBER 3, 2026 - GENERAL & SPECIAL ELECTIONS + NOVEMBER 3, 2026 - GENERAL AND SPECIAL ELECTIONS + NOVEMBER 3, 2026 - GENERAL ELECTION
